items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Like, what's the name? Marura and them fellas.

ctx.x: No two-three pieces. Did you have any singers at all, hadn't in the old days?

Well, most of the band, people would sing with the band, the man who'd lead, you see. The trumpet player and sometimes the guitar player. Sometimes the piano player, he'd sing what he know about a number. That's how it went. But they never had no regular singers unless you go to the entertainers when they had to have, and then you had to be a first class musician to play in the entertainer because they used to, sometimes the singers would put the music on.
